//: Copy to test-flow.json and fill in your own values. test-flow.json is gitignored.
//platformId: An ALREADY LOGGED IN platform id — email or ObjectId. The harness reads its cookies from platformids and never logs in; a dead session fails fast.
//addressId: id from the dashboard's addresses collection. gstId from gsts.
//checkoutPincode: Optional. Overrides the address's pincode, so deliverability can be flipped without editing address records.
//paymentMode: cod | card | none. none stops at /payments.
//stopAfter: payments (default) | payment_probe | pay. 'pay' ALSO needs payLive: true.
//cardType: Only for paymentMode=card. cards[] takes the same columns as the order form's CSV.
//productUrls: One per case id. Only `happy` is required. An out-of-stock product does not stay out of stock — keep these current.
